data.one_liner: A Flutter text widget that expands, collapses, and automatically parses URLs and custom text highlights.
data.what_it_does: Provides an expandable and collapsable text widget that can automatically detect URLs or custom regex patterns and turn them into clickable links. It also supports custom text highlighting with multiple phrases and priorities.
use_when: You need a 'read more / read less' text expansion feature
You need to automatically parse URLs in text into clickable links
You need to highlight specific target words or phrases with custom styles and actions
avoid_when: You only need standard static text without expansion or link parsing
You require complex rich text editing capabilities
strengths: Combines text expansion and URL parsing into a single widget
Supports custom regex for pattern recognition
Supports priority-based multi-word highlighting with custom click actions
weaknesses: Limited to widget-level text manipulation features provided out-of-the-box
data.setup_notes: No special native setup required; standard flutter package dependency.
